profiles.label: Auto-detect
profiles.description: Probe GPUs each time and pick the best matching profile.

profiles.label: CPU only
profiles.description: No usable NVIDIA GPU (or Ollama on CPU). Prefer tiny coder models.

profiles.label: Single GPU · ~8 GB
profiles.description: Laptop / entry cards (6–10 GB). Prefer 3B–14B class models.

profiles.label: Single GPU · ~12 GB
profiles.description: Common 10–14 GB cards. Prefer 14B; avoid 32B defaults.

profiles.label: Single GPU · ~16 GB
profiles.description: 14-20 GB cards (e.g. 4060 Ti 16GB). Prefer qwen3:14b / qwen3-coder:30b; may downshift from qwen3.6:35b.

profiles.label: Single GPU · ~24 GB
profiles.description: 20-28 GB cards (3090 / 4090). Comfortable headroom for qwen3.6:35b recommended packs.

profiles.label: Dual GPU · 12+16 GB
profiles.description: Two GPUs (~12 GB + ~16 GB). Up to two large loads when parallel.

profiles.label: Dual / multi GPU
profiles.description: Two or more GPUs that don't match the classic 12+16 split. Budget = largest card.

profiles.label: Workstation · 40 GB+
profiles.description: 40 GB+ single card or multi-GPU VRAM sum ≥ 40. Highest concurrency.
